instruction: I've created a Snake game in Python and everything works nicely! One thing that's bothering me though - the game window doesn't have a title, so it just shows the default pygame window name. Could you add a window title by calling pygame.display.set_caption with the title 'Snake Game'? This should be added right after the display is initialized. Thanks!
